oracle_rules: Requirements, hand-authored prompts, public validators and original independent behavior checks define expected behavior before implementation.
The production compiler cannot read corpora, stored answers or Python reference planners.
Historical reference plans and receipts are used only for regression comparison and legal alternate bundle intake; they are not new acceptance passes.
New tests execute CNL/JSON compilation, standalone bundle assembly and complete generated product behavior.
Fixes keep earlier failed attempts and rerun all impacted scopes on one final source; never splice successful receipts from different builds.
New missing boundary cases may be added with a written requirement reason; do not weaken frozen expected outcomes to match implementation.
